description: Implement a mechanism to properly cancel in-flight heartbeat gRPC calls when a worker stops. Currently, heartbeats can hang during worker shutdown because they use a non-cancellable context. We need to propagate a cancellable context that gets canceled during worker teardown to ensure clean shutdown.
functional_requirements: Create a dedicated cancellable context for heartbeat operations in the worker lifecycle
Use this cancellable context instead of context.Background() for all RecordWorkerHeartbeat gRPC calls
Ensure the heartbeat context is canceled before other shutdown signals are sent during worker.Stop()
Add test coverage to verify that stop() returns promptly even when heartbeat RPCs are blocked
